title: Nano Banana edits take up to four reference images from the prompt box - collaged into one before sending
description: Fabio 2026-09-25. DeepInfra exposes ONE reference image for the whole Nano Banana family (measured: a list is a 422; the OpenAI edits route with several images bills and silently keeps only the last; the chat route does not host image models). Google's model takes many, so one reference makes Nano Banana edits far weaker in the prompt box than they should be. Shape: the user adds up to four reference images in the prompt box for a Nano Banana edit as they would for Klein Edit; the app collages them into ONE square (2x2 grid, or fewer cells for 2-3 images) server-side before the call, and tells the model the layout in the prompt (which cell is which image), so the user's 'image 1 / image 2' wording still means something. Input billing is flat per image (1120 tokens on lite regardless of size, measured 2026-09-20), so the collage costs the same as one reference; the trade is resolution per reference. Seams to plan: routes/deepinfra.js takes a single imagePath today; the prompt box's reference-image count per model; the price tag (MPI-852) must not change; the sidecar should keep the ORIGINAL references for Reuse, not the collage. Test the grid wording on real edits before shipping. DeepInfra only (Fabio).
